typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{"Business Unit Number"} as string,
		{"TransactionSet (837P)"} as string,
		{"HIPAAVersion (005010X222A1)"} as string,
		{"Route Queue"} as string,
		{"Route Disposition"} as string,
		{"Billing Provider Primary ID"} as string,
		{"Billing Provider Tax Identification Number"} as string,
		{"Billing Provider Name"} as string,
		{"Submitter ID"} as string,
		{"Submitter Name"} as string,
		{"Payer ID"} as string,
		{"Patient Account Number"} as string,
		{"Patient Name"} as string,
		{"Service Date"} as string,
		{"(Unused Identifier Slot)"} as string,
		{"TP Claim Number"} as string,
		{"ISA-15 Usage Indicator"} as string,
		{"ISA-09 Interchange Date"} as string,
		{"ISA-08 Interchange Receiver ID"} as string,
		{"REF-F8 Other Payer Claim Control Number"} as string,
		{"BHT-03 Batch Control Number"} as string,
		{"(Unused Identifier Slot1)"} as string,
		{"(Unused Identifier Slot2)"} as string,
		{"(Unused Identifier Slot3)"} as string,
		{"Error or Message Code"} as string,
		{"Error or Message Text"} as string,
		{"Segment Number"} as string,
		{"Loop Name"} as string,
		{"Loop Instance"} as string,
		{"Segment Name"} as string,
		{"Segment Sequence"} as string,
		Element as string,
		SubElement as string,
		Data as string,
		{Subscriber ID} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CSVVelocediFile	source(output(
		clcl_id as string,
		source_system as string,
		claim_type as string,
		grgr_ck as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  clcl_id, source_system, claim_type, grgr_ck FROM [DX_EDI].[dbo].A2AMonthlyClaimsImport (NOLOCK)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
CSVVelocediFile split(left(toString("Error or Message Code"), 2) == 'H1' || (left(toString("Error or Message Code"), 2) == 'H2'), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(H1H2Errors,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
OLEDBSource sort(asc(clcl_id, false)) ~> Sort
ConditionalSplit1@H1H2Errors derive({} = {}) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive(Claim_number = right('00000' + {"Patient Account Number"}, 12),
		FileName837 = $FileName837,
		ConfigID = $ConfigID) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of Claim_number} = toString(Claim_number),
		{Copy of FileName837} = toString(FileName837)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sort(asc(Claim_number, false)) ~> SortFF
SortFF,Sort join(Claim_number == clcl_id,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(Claim_number = Claim_number,
		{"Error or Message Code"} = {"Error or Message Code"},
		{"Error or Message Text"} = {"Error or Message Text"},
		{Copy of Claim_number} = {Copy of Claim_number},
		{Copy of FileName837} = {Copy of FileName837},
		ConfigID = ConfigID) ~> MergeJoinREFORMAT1
MergeJoinREFORMAT1 sink(input(
		ErrorDescription as string,
		ClaimID as string,
		ErrorNumber as string,
		ConfigID as string,
		FileName837 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ErrorDescription = {"Error or Message Text"},
		ClaimID = {Copy of Claim_number},
		ErrorNumber = {"Error or Message Code"},
		ConfigID,
		FileName837 = {Copy of FileName837})) ~> OLEDBDestination
